title: Lumiya, a Half-Human
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: Lumiya, a Half-Human half-machine cyborg is the new "Dark Lord" in Marvel Comics' STAR WARS universe. Here (front), she looms over Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia Organa in a gouache painting for Marvel STAR WARS #95 by artist Kent Williams, who frequently tackles the dark side of human nature. His preliminary version is on the back. (Collection of William Plumb.)
